subject: Hosted API pricing concession for Opal Health — exec variance request
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@opalhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-24 09:12 PDT
Subject: Hosted API pricing request — Opal pilot

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Opal Health is ready to move a pilot into production across three clinics, but economics are tight for our procurement year. Our CFO asked whether Redwood can support a 30% off list Hosted API rate for the first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month minimum committed spend and co-marketing mention on our partner page. We can sign an MSA quickly if terms are acceptable.

Key points:
- Pilot scope: ingest+generate for triage workflows (est. 150M tokens/month ramping to 400M by Q2)
- Commitment: 12 months, forecast attached
- Ask: 30% discount against current Hosted API unit rates; standard security/SLAs otherwise

I attached our usage forecast and a draft MSA redline (Legal_T&Cs_Redlines.pdf). Can you escalate for executive review? This is time-sensitive — procurement calendar closes 10/31.

Best,
Sara Chen
Head of Partnerships, Opal Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-24 11:18 PDT
Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API pricing request — Opal pilot (need exec variance?)

Looping finance and CRO — initial read: Opal's forecast and the 12-month commit make this strategically interesting but 30% is outside standard rate bands (>20% requires exec variance).

My suggested guardrails if we consider approving 30%:
- 12-month minimum committed spend with quarterly true-ups and a 30-day termination notice only if we materially miss forecast
- 50% prepay of first two quarters (or equivalent escrow) to protect unit economics while they ramp
- SLA credit cap limited to 10% of monthly invoice (no unlimited credits)
- Legal: accept only limited redlines — no broad data residency changes without SSO/KMS review
- Co-marketing commitment (customer reference + case study) and marketplace listing within 90 days

I'll defer to Mina on finance constraints and Marcus for final authorization. If Marcus can sign off conditionally, legal and I will prepare a concession exhibit.

Ben
Deal Desk — Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-25 09:03 PDT
Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API pricing request — Opal pilot (finance stance)

Thanks Ben — reviewed numbers. 

Finance position: 30% bluntly reduces gross margin below our target for Hosted API on this volume profile unless we get strong protections. Conditions we need before recommending approval: 
- 12-month firm commitment with milestone-based payment schedule; prefer 60% prepayment of Y1 or quarterly prepay tiered by ramp (we can compromise to 50% if co-marketing and case study guaranteed)
- Strict overage pricing at list after commit is exhausted (no automatic blended rate)
- No refundable credits outside SLA caps; unlimited indemnities are unacceptable

If Opal agrees to 50% prepay + firm quarterly forecast and DocuSign within 7 business days, finance will recommend a one-time 30% concession for the first 12 months only. Otherwise, the max approveable concession without CRO signoff is 20%.

I'll prepare the finance checklist and projected P&L impact.

Mina Haddad
VP Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-26 15:04 PDT
Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API pricing request — Opal pilot (final decision)

Team — after reviewing the customer profile, ramp plan, and finance guardrails, I authorize a one-time 30% concession on Hosted API list for Opal Health for the first 12 months under the following binding conditions: 

1) Contract conditions (must be in the executed DocuSign):
   - 12-month minimum commitment and forecast attached as Exhibit A;
   - 50% of Year 1 committed spend paid upfront within 10 business days of DocuSign execution;
   - Explicit overage at list pricing after commit;
   - SLA credit cap = 10% monthly invoice; no other unusual liability expansion.
2) Marketing / GTM: customer commits to a co-marketing case study + marketplace listing within 90 days or the concession reverts to 20% for the remaining term.
3) Legal must confirm redlines are within our standard concessions (no material changes to data-residency/KMS without SOC2/HSM review) and attach concession exhibit.
4) This concession applies only to Hosted API unit rates referenced in the attached forecast; any Dedicated or Private deployment requests are out of scope.

Ben / Legal: please prepare the concession exhibit and DocuSign package reflecting these conditions. Aditya: let Opal know we can proceed if they accept the conditions and return a signed DocuSign by 2026-10-31.

Marcus Lin
Chief Revenue Officer — Redwood Inference
